notes.title: Version update on May 29, 2025
notes.content:
1. After setting the language, the issue of returning to default English after entering the game again has been fixed
2. The skill page has been reduced in size, no longer obstructing the shortcut bar
3. Weaken the damage of the first level Dark Knight
4. Fix the issue where some monsters are still locked after death
5. Optimize the problem of difficult climbing in some places
6. Optimize performance and increase frame rate
7. The task page can hide functions (press the H key to hide or display the taskbar)
